timeline.message:
Fixes 92541 and 92562

An optimization in the GeoHexGridTiler has exceptions for polygons
with two bounding points within the polar cells, but not all points
within those cells. The normal hexRing neighbour search is unsufficient
due to planar projection distortions.

We found that just one additional next-neighbour cell was needed for
each polar cell to maintain the optimization.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/92541
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/92562
timeline.author: Craig Taverner

timeline.body:
An optimization in the GeoHexGridTiler has exceptions for polygons
with two bounding points within the polar cells, but not all points
within those cells. So when the cells are polar we do an additional
check for the other two bounds.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/92541
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/92562
Hi @craigtaverner, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Changed label to non-issue (from bug) because this is a fix to an unreleased feature (geohex over geoshape). And force pushed a rebase back to before the changelog yaml.
